baseline: Deck-plank material made long pier shafts look horizontally striped; tall scenery quays lacked bracing.
firstNativeReview: Timber grain and frame geometry read clearly, but the iron joint plates were partly buried in the thick main posts.
correction: Move each plate centre from 0.48m to 0.84m outside the post centreline, seating its back against the timber/brace face; bolts follow the plate.
scope: Only scenery structure. No authored level, player, collision, support or camera changes.
